lines: // block.interact: a player uses the spark lamp with the main hand. Petals fall from above it,
// and pieces of the lamp itself (a block options object) burst around it.
e.world.spawnParticle({ type: "minecraft:block", block_state: "msm_sample_particles:spark_lamp" }, e.block.pos.offset(0.5, 0.5, 0.5), { count: 16, spread: 0.4 });
msm.log.info("block.interact: " + e.player.name + " used the spark lamp at " + e.block.pos);
